title: Bacon And Feta Stuffed Chicken Breast
blurb: Butterflied rather than pocketed, so the feta and bacon end up as a full layer running through the chicken instead of a small stuffed center.

ingredients.note: small, about 8 oz each, boneless, skinless
about 3 oz, crumbled, garlic and herb preferred, divided
slices, cooked, crumbled or chopped, divided

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Lightly grease a medium baking dish large enough to fit both chicken breasts.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper in a small bowl; set aside.

Butterfly the chicken breasts and place them in the prepared baking dish. Fill each with about 1 ounce of the feta and a third of the bacon (if doubling, use two-thirds of the bacon per breast). Close the breasts and sprinkle the remaining cheese and bacon over the top.
Pour the olive oil mixture over the breasts and bake 25 to 35 minutes (longer for very large breasts), until an instant-read thermometer reads 160 to 165°F.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving. Spoon the pan drippings over rice or vegetables, or serve with orzo.
